Name: Lightning Bolt
Components: V, S, M (a bit of fur and a rod of amber, crystal, or glass)
Description: A stroke of lightning forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 8d6 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The lightning ignites flammable objects in the area that aren’t being worn or carried.
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell at 4th level or higher, you may choose one of the following effects for each level above 3rd:

• The lightning damage increases by 1d6.
• The line’s length increases by 50 feet.
• (2 levels) Any creature who fails their saving throw by 5 points or more is stunned until the start of their next turn.
• (2 levels) You may fire a second identical bolt of lightning in another direction. Creatures hit by two or more lightning bolts are only affected once.
